intro: Battleboar Snouts are harvested from the aggressive boars trained by the Bristleback quilboar in Mulgore. Collected by young tauren hunters, they serve both as proof of thinning an invasive threat and as hearty ingredients for tribal cooking in Camp Narache.

p: In the shadow of Red Cloud Mesa, the Bristleback quilboar train malicious battleboars within Brambleblade Ravine to probe tauren hunting grounds. When young braves are sent out by Grull Hawkwind to push back against this encroachment, the snout serves as undeniable proof of a beast brought down. Rather than wasting any part of the kill, the tauren use these snouts alongside cuts of flank to prepare rich, sustaining stews to feed their young.
